caption: The drawing displays six rectangular objects arranged in two horizontal rows of three. Each object appears to be a horse saddlebag or horse blanket design, depicted with a U-shaped arch at the bottom and side ties or tassels. The top left object is light green with a circular motif in orange and yellow at the center. The top center object has a yellow field with a geometric rainbow-like pattern in red, orange, and yellow above, and blue horizontal bands near the top and bottom edges. The top right object features a blue background with red, green, and white geometric shapes, including a diamond and triangular forms. The bottom left object has a green main color with a stepped-pattern triangle in yellow and red. The bottom center object is predominantly gray with a hint of green and purple and has a blue band containing four white rectangles. The bottom right object has a purple and green field featuring a large central red triangle with a yellow stepped motif atop it. All objects are drawn on a plain beige background, and each one is outlined in black pencil or ink.
title: Head Pieces
